# crosswork_demand_matrix_global_configuration (Data Source)

This data source can read the global configuration of the demand matrix.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_demand_matrix_global_configuration" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `computation_cadence` (Number) Interval in minutes at which the demand matrix is computed
- `debug_max_plan_files` (Number) Maximum number of debug plan files to save
- `debug_mode` (Boolean) Enables the debug optimizer
- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `minimum_demand_traffic` (Number) Demands with traffic below this value in Kbps are excluded from the demand matrix
